%1$s is an offline calculation aid for organizing gas pipe sizing arithmetic from your own readings, including comparing the capacity you confirmed against the load you need. It can also return a capacity from the table you record yourself, naming the row it used. It supplies no code tables and does not determine compliance. A recorded table is compared only on material or system, inlet pressure class and gas specific gravity; the fuel and the permitted pressure drop you recorded for a table are not compared, and nothing you record is verified or corrected.

Your case is saved on this device and restored when you reopen the app. It is never sent anywhere. Verify every result against your own applicable code book; this app is not a certification or endorsement.

A field notebook for the pipe sizing arithmetic you already do on paper, plus the citation that says where each reading came from.
What this app does and does not do

It sums the loads and developed lengths you type, converts imperial and metric units in both directions, and compares the capacity you confirmed against the load you need. From a capacity table you record yourself, it can also return the capacity recorded for a size and length, or the smallest recorded size that carries your load, naming the row it used. It compares your material or system, inlet pressure class and gas specific gravity with the values you recorded for that table; it does not compare the fuel or the permitted pressure drop you recorded for that table. It ships no code tables, names what to correct instead of asserting a result when a reading is missing, unusable, out of range, absent from the table you recorded, or inconsistent with the selected method, and it does not certify compliance.
Why a result can be refused

A number produced for the wrong code edition, unit or method is worse than no number. When a reading is missing, unparseable, out of range, or inconsistent with the selected method, the app names what to correct instead of calculating.

Your cases are stored on this device and restored when you reopen the app. They are never uploaded. Free-tier builds show interstitial and rewarded ads through Google AdMob; Pro removes them.
